sources.verified_angle_summary: Ignite - National Technology Fund, under Pakistan's Ministry of IT & Telecom, is officially participating in LEAP 2026 by sponsoring and bringing 10 promising Pakistani startups to the global tech event in Riyadh. The startups represent diverse sectors including AI, SaaS & Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, RetailTech, Cleantech, and Robotics. They will be showcased at Hall 3, Booth E108 at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center from August 31 to September 3, 2026. This initiative highlights Pakistan's growing technology and entrepreneurship ecosystem on the global stage, offering these startups a platform to connect with international investors, visionary founders, and potential partners. This specific angle provides a concrete example of a national initiative supporting startups at LEAP, moving beyond generic event statistics.
